title: CoilStats
description: Computed electrical and geometric statistics for a single coil. Returned by POST /api/stats. Not stored in the project file — recomputed on demand.

wireLength.description: Total wire length, metres. = circumference × turns.

wireMass.description: Total wire mass, kg. = CU_DENSITY × wireLength × wire.area.

resistance.description: DC resistance, ohms. = CU_RESISTIVITY × wireLength / wire.area. Uses bare copper area.

numLayers.description: ceil(turns / turnsPerLayer). 0 if wire does not fit.

channelDepth.description: Total depth needed, metres. = numLayers × wire.insulatedD.

fitsInChannel.description: True if turnsPerLayer >= 1 (wire physically fits in the channel).

errors.description: Physically invalid or impossible conditions. Blocks export.
